title: Faction
description: A playable side with its own units and buildings.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

ai.title: AI Weights
ai.description: How the Faction's Battle AI plays: each weight scales one kind of choice; 1 is neutral.

aggression.description: How much it goes after enemy squads it can see. Defaults to 1.

caution.description: How much enemies near a goal put it off, and how readily a hurt squad regroups. Defaults to 1.

cover.description: How much it prefers cover and high ground when it stops to fight or hold. Defaults to 1.

raid.description: How much it goes after enemy buildings. Defaults to 1.

scout.description: How much it searches when it can see no enemy. Defaults to 1.

bot.title: Bot Weights
bot.description: How the Faction's Bots play the galaxy map: each weight scales one goal, times its difficulty's; 1 is neutral. See docs/specs/bot-spec.md.

names.description: Its Bots' names, taken in order; a Bot past the end is named by its Seat.

startingKit.title: Starting Kit
startingKit.description: Placed on the Faction's Capital when a Match starts. Starting resources are a lobby setting, not part of the kit.
